about: The two closed lists of things reacting (Soul Actions SA-F15, #2853), one file shared with Engine v2 E18 (#2788): what may start a rule, and what a rule may do. A rule never chooses, never draws, never moves a body and acts on no offer or activity. Each list grows only with the task that first needs a new member.

changed.means: a field of this thing changes

linked_changed.means: a field of a thing linked to it by a named link changes

support_changed.means: a field of the thing it rests on changes, or it comes to rest on a thing where that field differs

rested.means: something comes to rest on it

body_entered.means: a body enters the place it is in

body_left.means: a body leaves the place it is in

due.means: a time it scheduled comes due: a timer one of its forms set, by name

world.means: the world announces a change of light or weather (Engine v2 E6, #2755)

set.means: set a field to a constant, or to the trigger's new value; setting a field to its own value is no change and triggers nothing

add.means: add a whole amount to an int field, held within its min and max

rate.means: set the rate per second of a timed field, settling its value at that time (Engine v2 F5, #2770)
